title: MySQL memory scopes
purpose: Show one shared scope versus independent session-local allocations, matching examples from document and original.
alt: MySQL 공유 메모리와 세션별 독립 메모리의 대표 버퍼 및 캐시
requiredChecks: Shared region includes InnoDB buffer pool, MyISAM key cache, Adaptive hash index, Redo log buffer and Table cache; no shared Binary log buffer.
Each separate session contains Join, Sort, Network and Read buffers plus Binary log cache; no cross-session sharing connector.
Both connection headings have access arrows to shared scope; the caption states query buffers are allocated as needed.
prompt: Edit MySQL memory scopes: shared five cards InnoDB buffer pool, MyISAM key cache, Adaptive hash index, Redo log buffer, Table cache. Session A and B each have private Join buffer, Sort buffer, Network buffer, Read buffer, Binary log cache. Preserve shared access arrows and allocation-as-needed caption.
secondReviewOriginalBasis: Original untracked PNG was retired in the prior session and cannot be recovered; independently reviewed current document and official MySQL sources. originalViewed records the historical first pass, not this second pass.
